title: Unified storage client/server independent-deploy compatibility rule
answers: Can client and server sides of unified storage be deployed at different versions?
What must be true when changing the resource gRPC proto contract?
Why is there a CI check blocking PRs that touch both client and server storage code?
body: Client (apistore/, federated/, callers in pkg/registry/apis/) and server (resource/, sql/, search/, migrations/) sides of unified storage can deploy at different cadences. pkg/storage/unified/AGENTS.md states: the same commit can be live on one side and not the other. Consequence: contract changes must be additive/backward-compatible. proto/search.proto has a reserved field number once mapped, never reused; UNSPECIFIED enum values must fall back to old defaults. This is enforced mechanically: unified/semgrep/resource-search-field-values.yaml fails CI if a ResourceSearchRequest literal omits ResultFormat FIELD_VALUES. A CI workflow (pr-unified-storage-compatibility.yml) blocks PRs touching client and server sides together unless a no-check-unified-storage-compatibility label with justification is applied.
applies: Applies to any change touching the resourcepb/proto contract or code in both apistore/federated and resource/sql/search/migrations in the same PR; does not apply to changes confined to one side only.
